hero.headline: Moments That
hero.description: From industry expos to team milestones — a visual journey through the events, achievements, and people that make Invendis.

photos.title: Intel ISB Connect 2026
photos.caption: Showcase of the latest Intel Edge Devices at the Taj Hotel, Bengaluru, on 13th August 2026

photos.title: Coins Partner Awards 2025
photos.caption: Invendis received the business excellence award at the Coins IT Partner Summit 5.0 held from 15-17 December 2025 in Goa

photos.title: ElAsia 2026
photos.caption: Invendis participated in ElAsia from May 14-17 2026

photos.title: Automation Expo 2026
photos.caption: Invendis participated in the Industrial Automation Expo 2026, one of India's largest events for automation related technology from 22nd-25th July 2026.

photos.title: Embedded World Germany 2026
photos.caption: Took part in Embedded World Germany, the only trade show dedicated to the latest embedded technology from 10-12 March 2026

photos.title: Intel Alderlake Award
photos.caption: Invendis received an award for designing the Alderlake Power-On Board in a record 3 days under the Make in India initiative in March 2026
